sci-repo-y8-aran-2014-scimethod-mc-1.title: Year 8 Science — Scientific method test — Aranmore 2014 (original source MC)
sci-repo-y8-aran-2014-scimethod-mc-1.coverage: Original assessment questions with source figures. Written parts remain in the bank with marks and parent context. Review-required items excluded from automatic battles.

questions.prompt: A description of the steps taken in an experiment is called the:
questions.explanation: The method describes the experimental steps.

questions.prompt: The correct prefix symbol for milli is:
questions.explanation: Lowercase m denotes milli (10⁻³); uppercase M denotes mega.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is not an example of second-hand data?
questions.explanation: Data collected directly in your own experiment are first-hand data.

questions.prompt: An error due to guessing a measurement between an instruments markings would be:
questions.explanation: Reading/interpolation uncertainty is the intended category for estimating between scale divisions.

questions.prompt: Whether or not the hypothesis in an experiment was proved or disproved is written in the:
questions.explanation: The conclusion evaluates whether the results support the hypothesis. A single experiment does not ordinarily prove a hypothesis absolutely.
